name: Plangger Delikatessen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Plangger Delikatessen in Ischgl**

Discover the finest **Tirol** specialties at **Plangger Delikatessen** in **Ischgl**, where tradition meets quality. Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, freshly baked **Strudel**, and artisanal **Speck** and **Käse** from the region. Enjoy local **Apfelstrudel**, **Topfenknödel**, and **Tiroler Gröstl**—all made with love and the finest ingredients.

Our selection of **Tiroler** wines, **Obazda**, and **Brezen** will make your visit unforgettable. Whether you're looking for a sweet treat or a savory snack, **Plangger Delikatessen** is your go-to spot in **Ischgl** for authentic **Tiroler** flavors. Come by and taste the heart of **Tirol**!
